name: Cui bien mai nuong
summary: A local seed grilled over the fire, eaten as a snack at Bãi Sao and inside the national park.
origin: Phu Quoc. Bãi Sao and the park, on the Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam accounts.
howToEat: Snack on it after a swim at Bãi Sao or on the park walk.
where: Bãi Sao and the park streams.
seoTitle: Cui bien mai nuong — the grilled seed at Bai Sao
seoDescription: Cùi biên mai nướng is a grilled local seed, the snack at Bãi Sao and on the national park walk.
